rules.DIRECT: same structure, material and conditions; a value or definition is taken
rules.CLOSE_ANALOG: similar structure; supports a modelling choice, never a value
rules.CONTEXT_ONLY: qualitative background or a reason not to claim; no number taken
rules.NOT_HELD: no full text or metadata in this environment; nothing drawn, not cited

sources.held: EXTRACTED CONDITIONS ONLY (Cu-Cu bump EM under accelerated stress): research/phase0naj/pad_count_closure.json
sources.use: marks the ~1e6 A/cm2 regime in which accelerated Cu-Cu bump EM is observed, to flag the smallest pad counts

sources.title: Research on Electromigration Failure Behavior of Redistribution Layer Based on Electrothermal Coupling
sources.use: supports evaluating the package RDL resistance at temperature inside the E-T fixed point (the ledger scales it with rho_Cu(T) at the package-layer temperature)
sources.caveat: its accelerated current densities are NOT a design allowable

sources.title: TSV Electromigration Failure Prediction Using Multiphysics Coupled Energy Method
sources.use: reliability needs current density, temperature and stress together; the reason no TSV current-density allowable is claimed
sources.caveat: qualitative only

sources.title: Accumulated Creep Strain and Energy Density Based Thermal Fatigue Life Prediction Models for SnAgCu Solder Joints (Syed, ECTC 2004)
sources.use: shows why a published life model does not transfer: SAC405/395 balls, creep-only metrics, volume averaging over a 25 um layer valid only for that thickness
sources.caveat: no constant or life model is taken; the paper reports response, not life

sources.held: CITATION RECORD ONLY (Darveaux 2002, ASME, closed access): results/ETM_DVPD_FULL_TECHNICAL_REPORT.md
sources.use: life correlations are calibrated to their own simulation procedure, so an absolute life from this procedure would not be admissible
